body:
## Summary
LGTM — clean, well-scoped addition that follows existing conventions closely.

## Notes
- Verified `formatChangelogDate`/`buildChangelogEntries` sorting (date desc, then agent name asc) and the "unknown" author fallback logic in `lib/changelog.ts` — correct and well tested in `tests/changelog.test.ts`.
- `ChangelogSource`/`ChangelogSourceUpdate` are intentionally looser than the registry's `AgentLibraryEntry`/`BacklogAgent`/`AgentUpdate` types (author required + non-empty there, enforced by `requireString` in `lib/agent-registry.ts`), so the "unknown" fallback path isn't reachable via the current registry loader today — but it's reasonable defensive/testable design given the comment explicitly calls this out, not a real bug.
- Styling in `app/changelog/page.tsx` (page-wrap/page-title/page-subtitle/detail-block, list markup, Tailwind utility classes) mirrors the existing updates list in `app/backlog/[agentId]/page.tsx` almost line-for-line — good pattern reuse, no new one-off styles.
- Nav link addition in `lib/garage-content.ts` is placed sensibly next to Plan/Library/Backlog.
- Confirmed registry dates in `registry/agents/*.yaml` are bare `YYYY-MM-DD` today, so `formatChangelogDate` truncation is currently a no-op safety net rather than an active behavior change — fine either way.

No blocking or should-fix issues found.
